snippet.title: Orion Blue - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4264000/Orion_Blue/

Developer: EXLIX

#indiegame #pixelart #simulation
